mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM product WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE
SELECT enabled FROM category WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) FOR SHARE
SELECT enabled FROM brand WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) FOR SHARE

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM asset WHERE visibility='PUBLIC' AND size_bytes <= 5242880 AND content_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp') AND id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET state=#{state},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND version=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_asset WHERE product_id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_asset(product_id,asset_id,sort_order) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{assetId} AS UNSIGNED),#{sort})
mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,CAST(product_id AS CHAR) productId,code,specs_json specsJson,CAST(price_minor AS CHAR) priceMinor,enabled,version FROM sku
mapper.select: WHERE product_id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku(product_id,code,specs_json,specs_hash,price_minor,enabled) VALUES(CAST(#{productId} AS UNSIGNED),#{input.code},#{specsJson},#{specsHash},CAST(#{input.priceMinor} AS UNSIGNED),#{input.enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sku SET code=#{input.code},specs_json=#{specsJson},specs_hash=#{specsHash},price_minor=CAST(#{input.priceMinor} AS UNSIGNED), enabled=#{input.enabled},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND version=#{version}
